filesChanged: CHANGELOG.md of packages/envoy, contracts, envoy-client, claude-envoy, pi-envoy
trickyParts: A block's maker is known only when its first recorded version F is 1 or version F-1 was indexed by a block-aware build (refs.blockFirstVersion, one SQL fragment shared by the block loader, the ask loader and refs.RemovedBlockFacts); otherwise made_by [] and made_at null.

The ask edit lookup repeats events_ask_payload_id's type list so the planner uses the partial index. EXPLAIN on 3000 issues / 96000 events / 3000 asks: issue statement 'Index Scan Backward using events_issue_key_seq_key on events e, Index Cond: (issue_key = i.key), Filter: type = ANY(issue.created, issue.updated, issue.closed)' under a Limit 1; ask statement 'Bitmap Index Scan on events_ask_payload_id, Index Cond: ((payload ->> id) = k.id::text)', Filter type = ask.edited, under Limit 1. No sequential scan of events.

written_version is set by before-insert triggers so the earlier build's inserts during the roll are recorded; an insert that names a value keeps it; an approval ask records approval.version at opening, which the row's own approval.version later moves past.

component_facts has no foreign key to components (every import deletes and re-inserts them); the importer upserts by digest and deletes orphans, and the source delete route runs the same orphan delete.
deviations: The plan's two migrations (<N>_node_facts, <N+1>_written_version_backfill) are five (0129-0133): each migration locks one table, following 0123/0124 and 0075/0076 and the README's lock rules.
Migration numbers: the root issue's pull request (INFRA-156) also takes 0129; agreed over Envoy that whichever merges second renumbers its own migrations.

skills/dispatch is unchanged: its SKILL.md never describes what dispatch read prints, and the three Dispatch skills sit at 1,999 of the 2,000-word cap packages/pi-envoy/src/skills-guard.test.ts enforces. packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md is unchanged: the dashboard reads none of the facts.
The driver's architecture-source PUT and DELETE send actor {kind: session} (bearer callers must name one); its CLI Node: line checks leave room for a '(as <service>)' label after the session id.
